title: NPC
description: A named or working-name adult/institutional character. One file per NPC in data/npcs/. Most Directorate NPCs are purely social/narrative and never need `statblock` at all — only set it if this NPC could plausibly end up in a fight or an opposed check that needs real numbers.

pole.description: Which of the Directorate's three (non-stable) poles this NPC represents, if any.

ancestry.description: This NPC's ancestry, matching a `name` in data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json (51 entries). Added 2026-09-20: ancestry is load-bearing in this setting rather than decoration — the founders include a gnoll, the intake doctor is a literal skeleton, and 'make them non-human' has been a real casting instruction. Null or omitted means human or not yet decided; do not assume human from absence. Note that the catalogue mixes Golarion-native ancestries (Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, Leshy, Nuar) with genuinely alien ones (Shirren, Vesk, Ysoki, Barathu and the rest) — the distinction matters when casting, since 'non-human' and 'alien' are not the same ask here.

canon.description: The canon entity this person is (D080, 2026-10-07): the id of a file in canon/world/ ("manako" is canon/world/manako.md), or entity.slug for one person inside a group file that holds many ("night-regulars.kiku" is the facts of canon/world/night-regulars.md whose slug is kiku, or starts "kiku-"). null means there is no canon entity for them. What the person's Actor sheet says is generated from it: the settled facts, the open decisions flagged, a count of the pencil (tools/story/actor-notes.mjs, data/campaign/actor-notes.json). Required in every file by test/story/actor-notes.test.mjs, so a person is never left out by omission.

description.description: RETIRED 2026-10-07 (D080): an NPC file no longer carries story prose. The old text of all 86 files is kept, untouched, in quarantine/data/npc-descriptions.json; the story it told lives in canon/world/, and the Actor sheet's text is generated from canon (see `canon`). Nothing reads this field any more and test/story/actor-notes.test.mjs fails if a file has it.

crewChiefForRef.description: This NPC is the named head of one pilot's repair crew (campaign/config.json#frameEconomy.repairCrew) -- the id of the kid (data/characters/kids/) they serve. One crew chief per pilot, six total.

statblock.description: Optional combat/skill stat block, only needed if this NPC could plausibly roll dice against the party. Same shape as creature.schema.json.

socialProfile.description: Persistent, learnable social intel for the Character Card — see design/npc-social-intel.md. Optional; only worth authoring for recurring NPCs the party will meet more than once.

attitude.description: SF2E's real Attitudes scale (reference/srd/player-core/504-conditions-appendix.json), not an invented one.

text.description: The fact itself, e.g. "Easily bribed" or "Never forgets an insult."

revealTrigger.description: How a player learns this. Either a check, or a narrative condition.

revealedNote.description: When/how it was actually learned at the table, filled in live, not authored ahead of time.
